journey.name: arkade transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies that Arkade is the easy option where Transfer To Spending otherwise leads to Manual Setup. With Arkade ready, Funding leads with "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"), and the Savings and Spending transfer buttons open the Arkade amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") instead of the Transfer Unavailable sheet. The confirm screen shows the network fee and the Arkade boarding fee. Boarding needs the deposit confirmed on the chain Arkade runs on, so this journey stops before the swipe.
Precondition: dev build with Arkade connected on mutinynet (no key needed), onboarded wallet with a positive on-chain Savings balance and no channels. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending") and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens with the available amount, not the Transfer Unavailable sheet

Tap "Max" (testTag "SpendingAmountMax"), tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue") and verify the confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Boarding fee", "To spending" and "Total", and a swipe to transfer
Go back to the wallet home, open Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections and tap add connection (testTag "add_connection_button")

Verify "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") are enabled above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"), and "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware") is disabled
Tap "Transfer from Savings" and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens
